records.name: Structural carbon steel (generic)
records.note: Generic values for hand estimates, from open sources; no grade-specific strengths (A36, A992, S355 ...) because no open source for them has been entered yet.

density.note: 'Commonly reported as 7860 kg/m3 at 23 degC' (section 3.1.2, page 7)

youngs_modulus.note: 29,000,000 psi, 'for all grades of structural steel' (page 1-4): 199.9 GPa

poisson_ratio.note: mean of six specimens of structural low-carbon steel to ASTM A7-42 (3/8 in plate and 1/2 in angle), measured in 1946: 0.256 to 0.271 (low and high); fully killed carbon steel plate averages 0.271 (18 specimens, 0.263 to 0.279). Modern grades such as A36 and A992 were not tested

thermal_expansion.note: 6.5e-6 per degF as printed (page 1-4), the value the manual prescribes for steel

thermal_conductivity.note: Table 5, mild steel at 26.85 degC (page 8); it falls to 29.7 at 716.85 degC

specific_heat.note: Table 5, mild steel at 26.85 degC (page 8); it rises to 871 at 716.85 degC

records.name: Aluminium alloy 6061-T6
records.note: Typical values with the printed minimums as `low`. A 1972 handbook compiled largely from MIL-HDBK-5A, which is superseded (MMPDS replaced it): the minimums shown as `low` are that edition's A-basis or specification values, not current allowables.

density.note: 2.70 g/cm3 at 20 degC (0.098 lb/in3 at 68 degF), section 9.1, page 75

youngs_modulus.note: typical E 10.0 x 10^3 ksi (section 7.222, page 39); `low` is the design value 9.9 x 10^3 ksi (section 7.221)

thermal_expansion.note: mean 20 to 100 degC, 23.4 x 10^-6 per degC (section 9.22, page 75)

thermal_conductivity.note: T6 temper 0.40 cal/(cm s degC) at 25 degC (section 9.21, page 75, and the abstract, page iv); the NIST cryogenic fit in the nist-cryo pack gives 154 at 293 K, kept as `low`

yield_strength.note: typical tensile yield 40.0 ksi (abstract, page iv); `low` is the A-basis minimum 35 ksi for sheet, plate, bar, rod and shapes in T6 (Table 7.4111, page 43)

ultimate_strength.note: typical ultimate tensile strength 45.0 ksi (abstract, page iv); `low` is the A-basis minimum 42 ksi (Table 7.4111, page 43)

records.name: Titanium Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5), annealed
records.note: Annealed typical values with the printed minimums as `low`. A 1972 handbook compiled largely from MIL-HDBK-5A, which is superseded (MMPDS replaced it): the minimums shown as `low` are that edition's A-basis or specification values, not current allowables.

density.note: 4.424 g/cm3 at 20 degC (abstract, page iv); 0.160 lb/in3 (section 9.1, page 81)

youngs_modulus.note: typical E 16.5 x 10^3 ksi in tension (abstract, page iv); `low` is the design value 16.0 x 10^3 ksi for all forms (section 7.221, page 39)

thermal_expansion.note: mean 0 to 100 degC, 8.8 x 10^-6 per degC (abstract, page iv)

thermal_conductivity.note: NIST's log10 polynomial fit evaluated at 293 K; `rel_uncertainty` is NIST's stated fit error against its own data. The 1972 abstract prints 0.012 with garbled units, so it is not used

specific_heat.note: 0.135 cal/(g degC) at 20 degC as printed (abstract, page iv); an old value, check it against a current source

yield_strength.note: typical annealed tensile yield 128 ksi (abstract, page iv); `low` is the specification minimum 120 ksi for annealed plate 0.1876 to 4.000 in (Table 7.4111, page 42); the A-basis for sheet up to 0.1875 in is 126 ksi

ultimate_strength.note: typical annealed ultimate strength 138 ksi (abstract, page iv); `low` is the specification minimum 130 ksi for annealed plate 0.1876 to 4.000 in (Table 7.4111, page 42); the A-basis for sheet up to 0.1875 in is 134 ksi
